description: The Regular clone refined by 16 generations of evolution strategies on the Aggressive objective against Bot: Rookie. Held-out test reward 88.7 vs 73.7 for the clone it started from (not statistically significant, Welch t = 1.45); Bot: Regular scores 99.1 on the same matches.
name: Regular Clone + ES (Aggressive)

scenario.name: Sparring: jabber
